_help: Deal watches, run by tools/watch.py on every Karat Board build (every 30 min).
Add a watch = add an entry below. 'source' picks a reader in watch.py SOURCES;
'rule' picks a test in watch.py RULES. Set enabled false to pause one.
Rules: 'above' fires when an item's value >= 'above'.
'jump' fires when value >= its own average over the last 'window_days'
repeat_h: re-send a still-firing item after N hours; a rise of 'rise_pts' sends at once.
